From d3436a7f3240b8a657d35e417515d4e18fc9e396 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Adhemerval Zanella <adhemerval.zanella@linaro.org>
Date: Thu, 13 Feb 2020 08:27:27 -0300
Subject: [PATCH] alpha: Fix static gettimeofday symbol

By undef strong_alias on alpha implementation, the
default_symbol_version macro becomes an empty macro on static build.
It fixes the issue introduced at c953219420.

Checked on alpha-linux-gnu with a 'make check run-built-tests=no'.

diff --git a/time/gettimeofday.c b/time/gettimeofday.c
index 07c6e10d12..e4671edd13 100644
--- a/time/gettimeofday.c
+++ b/time/gettimeofday.c
@@ -35,6 +35,8 @@ ___gettimeofday (struct timeval *restrict tv, void *restrict tz)
   TIMESPEC_TO_TIMEVAL (tv, &ts);
   return 0;
 }
-
+/* Define to override default symbol version.  */
+#ifndef SET_VERSION
 strong_alias (___gettimeofday, __gettimeofday)
 weak_alias (___gettimeofday, gettimeofday)
+#endif
-- 
2.25.1



diff --git a/sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/alpha/gettimeofday.c b/sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/alpha/gettimeofday.c
index 7ad3c6a412..25e86410fd 100644
--- a/sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/alpha/gettimeofday.c
+++ b/sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/alpha/gettimeofday.c
@@ -18,12 +18,9 @@
 
 /* We can use the generic implementation, but we have to override its
    default symbol version.  */
-#undef weak_alias
-#define weak_alias(a,b)
-#undef strong_alias
-#define strong_alias(a, b)
+#define SET_VERSION
 #include <time/gettimeofday.c>
 
-_weak_alias (___gettimeofday, __wgettimeofday);
+weak_alias (___gettimeofday, __wgettimeofday);
 default_symbol_version (___gettimeofday, __gettimeofday, GLIBC_2.1);
 default_symbol_version (__wgettimeofday,   gettimeofday, GLIBC_2.1);

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `time/gettimeofday.c`**
   - Added a preprocessor directive to define `SET_VERSION` if it is not already defined. This change allows the `strong_alias` macro to be used without being overridden, ensuring that the default symbol versioning is applied correctly during static builds.

2. **File: `sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/alpha/gettimeofday.c`**
   - Removed the previous undefinitions and redefinitions of the `weak_alias` and `strong_alias` macros, which were used to override the default symbol versioning.
   - Introduced a definition for `SET_VERSION` to enable the use of the `weak_alias` macro correctly.
   - Adjusted the aliasing of `___gettimeofday` to `__wgettimeofday` to ensure proper symbol versioning is applied.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `time/gettimeofday.c` and `sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/alpha/gettimeofday.c` are interrelated. The change in `time/gettimeofday.c` ensures that the `strong_alias` macro is defined correctly for static builds, which is crucial for the proper functioning of the symbol versioning mechanism. Meanwhile, the adjustments in `sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/alpha/gettimeofday.c` leverage this new definition to correctly apply the weak aliasing and default symbol versioning for the `___gettimeofday` function. Together, these changes resolve the issue introduced in a previous commit (c953219420) by ensuring that the static `gettimeofday` symbol is handled correctly in the alpha architecture.
